1.3.1.1-r1.burton_quote: universal or particular, saith Gordonius, lil. med. cap. 19 part. 2, to persons, to species; some signs are secret, some manifest, some in the Body, some in the mind, and diversely vary, according to the inward or outward causes, Capivaccius: or from stars according to Jovianus Pontanus, de reb. coelest. lib. 10 cap. 13, and celestial influences, or from the humours diversely mixed
1.3.1.1-r1.translation: which, like wine, dispose the body in various ways; diverse phantasms according to the variety of the cause.

1.3.1.1-r2.burton_quote: lean, withered, hollow-eyed, look old, wrinkled, harsh, much troubled with wind, and a griping in their bellies, or belly-ache, belch often, dry bellies and hard, dejected looks, flaggy beards, singing of the ears, vertigo, light-headed, little or no sleep, and that interrupt, terrible and fearful dreams

1.3.1.1-r3.burton_quote: do eat much, yet they are lean, ill-liking, saith Aretaeus, withered and hard, much troubled with costiveness
